title: K-th Largest Array Value by Rank
description: Given an integer array `nums` and rank `k`, return the value that would appear in position `k` if the array were sorted in descending order. Duplicate values occupy separate positions. Input: `nums` and `k`. Output: the k-th largest value.
hints: Track the running prefix, window, or frequency information needed by the condition.
Check duplicates, all-equal values, and boundary-sized windows.
